questDescription->You receive an urgent message from the Science Department of [faction_name], sent by [asker_nameDef] from the department.

[asker_nameDef] tells you that during a recent collaboration between your colony and the Science Department, [birthdayPawnsInfo] joined the department's attendants in [yuanyin], forming a deep friendship.
Yesterday, while reviewing the schedule, they unexpectedly realized that [birthdayPawnsInfo]'s birthday is today. Following the traditional festival customs of Oberonia Aurea, they prepared some gifts for [birthdayPawnsInfo] at the cost of a few "reasonable experiment failures," and planned to visit your colony today. However, it seems they only remembered to submit a visit request right before setting out.

If you accept their visit request, they will arrive at your colony immediately and present some filled flower cakes as a congratulatory gift. During their stay, they will express blessings and goodwill to the birthday person, boosting their mood.
yuanyin->organizing accounting documents to deceive the Coordination Officer
yuanyin->discussing the subtle, unspoken romances within the Science Department
yuanyin->researching whether Hyacinth Research Officer's twin tails can actually be used as mining drills
yuanyin->assisting in improving and testing the Technology Department's flying trays
yuanyin->offering condolences to the Greater Forget-me-not Research Officer, whose travel plans were once again delayed due to an accident
yuanyin->pondering the feasibility and poisoning probability of colorful spaghetti
yuanyin->maintaining scientific equipment in the Science Department that malfunctioned due to improper use
yuanyin->making a small batch of Oberonia Aurea flower cakes and a large amount of unidentified kitchen waste
yuanyin->discussing bizarre food safety rumors circulating in the community
yuanyin->exchanging research perspectives to inspire one another
yuanyin->conducting discussions and research on anti-gravity technology
birthdayVisitorsArriveLetterText->[asker_nameDef]和其他[lodgersLabelSingularOrPlural]前来为[birthdayPawnsInfo]送上生日礼物，她们将在你的殖民地停留半日，并在此期间为遇到的生日者传递祝福。
lodgersLeavingLetterText->[asker_nameDef]和其他[lodgersLabelSingularOrPlural]在完成此行的目的后准备返回了。
